summary: On 32-bit targets, inline capacity 16711422 encodes as [254, 254, 254, 254], colliding with the old heap-capacity marker. Decoding therefore incorrectly treats an inline capacity as heap-stored. The fix uses 255 for the marker's capacity bytes, retaining HEAP_MASK only in the final byte, placing the marker beyond valid inline capacities. The selected test was added by this fix and requires a 32-bit target to detect this regression; it belongs to the compact_str library package, not compact_str-fuzz. No tests were executed.
